import sys
import numpy as np

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    MOD = 998244353
    N = int(data[0]); Q = int(data[1])
    arr = np.array(data[2:2+2*Q], dtype=np.int64)
    P = arr[0::2].copy()
    V = arr[1::2].copy()
    I = np.arange(Q, dtype=np.int64)

    Ia = I[:, None]; Ib = I[None, :]
    Va = V[:, None]; Vb = V[None, :]
    # edge iff (index order) and (value order) disagree
    D = ((Ia < Ib) & (Va > Vb)) | ((Ia > Ib) & (Va < Vb))
    del Ia, Ib, Va, Vb

    color = np.full(Q, -1, dtype=np.int64)
    comp = np.full(Q, -1, dtype=np.int64)
    ncomp = 0
    for s in range(Q):
        if color[s] != -1:
            continue
        color[s] = 0
        comp[s] = ncomp
        queue = [s]
        while queue:
            u = queue.pop()
            nb = np.nonzero(D[u])[0]
            if nb.size == 0:
                continue
            cs = color[nb]
            if np.any(cs == color[u]):
                print(0)
                return
            un = nb[cs == -1]
            if un.size:
                color[un] = 1 - color[u]
                comp[un] = ncomp
                queue.extend(un.tolist())
        ncomp += 1

    ai, bi = np.nonzero(D)
    mask = ai < bi
    ai = ai[mask]; bi = bi[mask]

    if ai.size > 0:
        if np.any(P[ai] == P[bi]):
            print(0)
            return
        f = np.where(color[ai] == 0, P[ai] < P[bi], P[bi] < P[ai]).astype(np.int64)
        cid = comp[ai]
        E = np.bincount(cid, minlength=ncomp).astype(np.int64)
        F = np.bincount(cid, weights=f, minlength=ncomp).astype(np.int64)
        consistent = np.all((F == 0) | (F == E))
        if not consistent:
            print(0)
            return
    else:
        E = np.zeros(ncomp, dtype=np.int64)

    isolated = int(np.sum(E == 0))
    ans = pow(2, isolated, MOD)
    print(ans % MOD)

import sys
import numpy as np

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0]); q = int(data[1])
    P = np.zeros(q, dtype=np.int64)
    V = np.zeros(q, dtype=np.int64)
    for i in range(q):
        P[i] = int(data[2 + 2 * i])
        V[i] = int(data[3 + 2 * i])
    MOD = 998244353

    hasL = np.zeros(q, dtype=bool)
    hasR = np.zeros(q, dtype=bool)
    deg = np.zeros(q, dtype=bool)

    for i in range(q):
        if i + 1 >= q:
            break
        vs = V[i + 1:]
        m = vs < V[i]
        if not m.any():
            continue
        ks = np.nonzero(m)[0] + i + 1
        pk = P[ks]
        pi = P[i]
        if (pk == pi).any():
            print(0)
            return
        deg[i] = True
        deg[ks] = True
        if (pk > pi).any():
            hasL[i] = True
        if (pk < pi).any():
            hasR[i] = True
        # k forced: if pi < pk then k is R; if pi > pk then k is L
        hasR[ks[pk > pi]] = True
        hasL[ks[pk < pi]] = True

    if (hasL & hasR).any():
        print(0)
        return

    iso = int(q - deg.sum())
    print(pow(2, iso, MOD))

import numpy as np

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    MOD = 998244353
    n = int(data[0]); q = int(data[1])
    arr = np.array(data[2:2 + 2 * q], dtype=np.int64).reshape(q, 2)
    P = arr[:, 0].copy()
    V = arr[:, 1].copy()
    free = 0
    for j in range(q):
        mask = np.zeros(q, dtype=bool)
        if j > 0:
            mask[:j] = V[:j] > V[j]
        if j + 1 < q:
            mask[j + 1:] = V[j + 1:] < V[j]
        if not mask.any():
            free += 1
            continue
        pp = P[mask]
        pj = P[j]
        if (pp == pj).any():
            print(0)
            return
        need_a = bool((pp > pj).any())  # j must be prefix (smaller P)
        need_b = bool((pp < pj).any())  # j must be suffix (larger P)
        if need_a and need_b:
            print(0)
            return
    print(pow(2, free, MOD))

import sys
import numpy as np

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    N = int(data[0]); Q = int(data[1])
    P = np.zeros(Q, dtype=np.int64)
    V = np.zeros(Q, dtype=np.int64)
    for i in range(Q):
        P[i] = int(data[2 + 2 * i])
        V[i] = int(data[3 + 2 * i])
    MOD = 998244353
    idx = np.arange(Q)
    isolated = 0
    for t in range(Q):
        pt = P[t]
        vt = V[t]
        earlier = idx < t
        later = idx > t
        gtV = V > vt
        ltV = V < vt
        eqP = P == pt
        # equal P with an inversion edge -> impossible
        if np.any((earlier & gtV & eqP) | (later & ltV & eqP)):
            print(0)
            return
        gtP = P > pt
        ltP = P < pt
        A = bool(np.any(earlier & gtV & gtP) or np.any(later & ltV & gtP))
        B = bool(np.any(earlier & gtV & ltP) or np.any(later & ltV & ltP))
        if A and B:
            print(0)
            return
        if not A and not B:
            isolated += 1
    print(pow(2, isolated, MOD))

import numpy as np

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    MOD = 998244353
    N = int(data[0]); Q = int(data[1])
    arr = np.array(data[2:2+2*Q], dtype=np.int64).reshape(Q, 2)
    P = arr[:, 0].copy()
    V = arr[:, 1].copy()
    mustL = np.zeros(Q, dtype=bool)
    mustR = np.zeros(Q, dtype=bool)
    bad = False
    for i in range(1, Q):
        Vi = V[i]; Pi = P[i]
        idx = np.nonzero(V[:i] > Vi)[0]
        if idx.size == 0:
            continue
        Pk = P[idx]
        if np.any(Pk == Pi):
            bad = True
            break
        less = idx[Pk < Pi]
        greater = idx[Pk > Pi]
        if less.size and greater.size:
            bad = True
            break
        if less.size:
            mustL[less] = True
            mustR[i] = True
        if greater.size:
            mustR[greater] = True
            mustL[i] = True
    if not bad:
        if np.any(mustL & mustR):
            bad = True
    if bad:
        print(0)
        return
    free = int(np.sum(~mustL & ~mustR))
    print(pow(2, free, MOD))

        V[i] = int(data[3 + 2 * i])
    MOD = 998244353
    idx = np.arange(Q)
    iso = 0
    for i in range(Q):
        vi = V[i]
        pi = P[i]
        nb = ((idx > i) & (V < vi)) | ((idx < i) & (V > vi))
        ps = P[nb]
        if ps.size == 0:
            iso += 1
            continue
        if np.any(ps == pi):
            print(0)
            return
        gt = bool(np.all(ps > pi))
        lt = bool(np.all(ps < pi))
        if not (gt or lt):
            print(0)
            return
    print(pow(2, iso, MOD))
